statements.status_notes: Patch applied from Debian 0.8-18: core-fix-uncontrolled-recursion-bug-using-a-simple-loop-d.patch. Replaces recursive label parsing with an iterative loop to prevent stack exhaustion from crafted DNS packets.
Patch applied from Debian 0.8-18: core-fix-DoS-bug-by-removing-incorrect-assertion.patch. The same assertion fix that addresses CVE-2025-68276 also covers this variant.
Patch applied from Debian 0.8-18: core-fix-DoS-bug-by-changing-assert-to-return.patch. Replaces a reachable assertion with an error return to prevent daemon crash from crafted mDNS packets.
Patch applied from Debian 0.8-18: core-fix-DoS-bug-by-removing-incorrect-assertion.patch. Removes an incorrect assertion that could be triggered by crafted mDNS packets, causing a daemon crash.

Patches applied from Debian 0.8-18: avahi-daemon.conf-turn-off-wide-area.patch disables wide-area DNS by default, and core-refuse-to-create-wide-area-record-browsers-when-wide.patch enforces the setting in the daemon core.
Patch applied from Debian 0.8-18: Properly-randomize-query-id-of-DNS-packets.patch. Randomizes DNS transaction IDs to prevent prediction attacks on wide-area DNS queries.
